text:
maria: quick heads-up — deploybot has a 17:00 UTC job to flip v2 for api-route `/v1/chat` -> `/v2/chat` gradual split. I noticed an SDK behavior mismatch during staging.

sahil: what mismatch?

maria: mobile sdk does an automatic retry on 429 that replays the original request with no idempotency-key. v2 routing can cause double-processing for some endpoints if the backend interprets duplicate messages.

kevin: oof. do we have tenants that depend on exactly-once semantics?

mobile-eng: ping — we do have 2 big clients (tenant ids T-314, T-271) that depend on idempotent chat receipts. SDK team shipped retry-by-default in 3.2.0.

maria: logs from staging: `request_id=stg-9f12 attempt=2 status=200 duplicate_detected=false` but downstream shows repeated side-effects (message duplicated).

ops-bot: deploybot scheduled window: 2026-03-23T17:00:00Z -> 2026-03-23T19:00:00Z, canary 5% for 30m, then ramp.

kevin: propose we: 1) pause deploybot canary, 2) pin legacy clients to the v1 routing for 48h, 3) add idempotency-key header enforcement on v2 for chat write endpoints, 4) update release notes / SDK patch.

release-manager: we need operator-friendly rollback thresholds. suggest: - >=0.5% of chat-write responses returning duplicated-side-effect alerts OR - 15% increase in p95 latency for chat writes -> auto-pause. Agree?

anna: that sounds reasonable. Also add a quick compatibility note in the release notes: `If you use SDK <=3.2.0 with retry-on-429, please upgrade or set "retry_on_throttle": false`

maria: can deploybot add a temporary pin route for tenants T-314 and T-271? That will avoid user impact while we change SDK and add header enforcement.

deploybot: @maria I can apply tenant pins. Command: `/deploybot pin-route --tenant T-314,T-271 --route /v1/chat --duration 48h --reason "legacy-sdk-retry-idempotency"`

kevin: please run that NOW in staging and then in prod once we confirm logs are clear.

mobile-eng: we'll cut SDK 3.2.1 with a config toggle `disable_retry_on_429=true` and push an advisory to the two tenants. ETA 4 hours.

maria: ops — if we pause canary, can someone extend the maintenance window?

ops-bot: maintenance window extended by +2h on request of @maria. New window: 17:00 -> 21:00 UTC.

kevin: add to release notes: short bullet about idempotency header and SDK fix. Also mention the temporary tenant pin.

release-manager: I've drafted a short blurb for the public release notes and internal changelog. I'll paste here once updated.

release-manager: (draft) "v2 chat routing: improved performance and streaming. Important: chat write endpoints now recommend an `Idempotency-Key` header to avoid duplicate side-effects when clients retry requests. If you're using Mobile SDK <=3.2.0, please upgrade to 3.2.1 or set `retry_on_throttle` to false."

maria: looks good. Can we also add an operator checklist for rollback?

kevin: rollback checklist (ops eyes):
- set deploybot hold / pause canary
- pin affected tenants to /v1/chat (deploybot pin-route)
- rollback routing config to previous hash if necessary: `routing-config@sha=abc123`
- monitor: 429 rate, duplicate side-effect alerts, p95 latency, and customer complaints channel
- if duplicate side-effects exceed 0.5% or p95 latency spikes by 15% -> full stop and rollback

anna: can someone create a simple smoke probe that checks idempotency behavior? a request with `Idempotency-Key: smoke-<uuid>` should return 202 once and 409 on duplicates (we have a schema for duplicate detection).

maria: I'll add a quick curl snippet for ops to run:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v2/chat \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "Idempotency-Key: smoke-12345" \n  -d '{"tenant":"T-314","message":"probe"}'
```
Run twice; first should be accepted, second should return duplicate status 409 or a flagged event in the duplicate detector logs.

mobile-eng: once SDK patch is out we'll coordinate release notes and notify the tenants' platform engineers.

kevin: summary / action items:
- @deploybot: hold canary / apply tenant pins (T-314, T-271) for 48h — in staging now, then prod once verified
- @mobile-eng: cut 3.2.1 with retry toggle (ETA 4h)
- @maria/@anna: add idempotency note to release notes and internal ops checklist
- @ops-bot: extend window and stand by for smoke probe results
- @release-manager: publish advisory and coordinate tenant comms

maria: thanks all. I'll wait for deploybot confirmation and the staging probe results before we decide to proceed or reschedule. :thumbsup: 

deploybot: `OK — applied pin in staging for T-314,T-271. Will apply to prod after manual confirm: /deploybot apply-pin-prod --pin-id pin-1847`

kevin: manual confirm done. Prod pin apply queued.

ops-bot: prod pin applied by deploybot at 1719009500.

mobile-eng: SDK 3.2.1 published to npm + maven. Patch notes and advisory sent to tenant contacts.

maria: staging smoke probe results: first run 2026-03-23T15:42:11 accepted, second run returned duplicate flag and no double side-effect. Good.

kevin: with pins in place and SDK patch out, we can delay full v2 rollout until Monday morning quiet window. I'll update the deploybot schedule.

release-manager: publishing advisory now and updating changelog. I'll include operator rollback checklist and deploybot commands.

maria: closing for now. Re-open if probe flags or tenant reports come in. :white_check_mark:
